stem:
In a typing test, there were no ties.
- Lito scored higher than Mila.
- Nora scored lower than Mila but higher than Oscar.
- Pia scored higher than Lito.

Who ranked third?
hints: Turn every clue into "higher than" and build one line from highest to lowest.
Start with Lito above Mila, then place Nora and Oscar below Mila.
Add Pia where clue 3 puts her. With all five in one line, count from the top to find third place.

solution.methodName: Line them up, then test every case

steps.action: Clue 1: Lito is above Mila. Line: Lito, Mila.
Clue 2: Nora is below Mila and above Oscar. Line: Lito, Mila, Nora, Oscar.
steps.why: "Lower than Mila but higher than Oscar" puts Nora between them.

steps.action: Clue 3: Pia is above Lito. Line: Pia, Lito, Mila, Nora, Oscar.
steps.why: Lito was at the top, so Pia, who beat Lito, becomes first.

steps.action: Count from the top: 1st Pia, 2nd Lito, 3rd Mila.

trapNotes.Lito: Lito is second. Clue 3 puts Pia above him, and only Pia, so he is not third.
trapNotes.Nora: This happens if you forget Pia. Without her, Nora would be third. Pia is above Lito, which pushes everyone down one place, so Nora is fourth.
trapNotes.Pia: Pia scored higher than Lito, who is above everyone else, so Pia is first, not third.
